description.value: Harrison Lake Hotel is a pet-friendly hotel on a quiet side street in Harrison Hot Springs, just steps from the Harrison Hot Springs Public Pool and the village town centre. The surrounding region offers an abundance of outdoor pursuits including hiking, biking, canoeing, kayaking, and golfing, making it a natural base for touring cyclists exploring the Fraser Valley. The hotel includes a Courtyard Cafe serving a continental breakfast buffet as part of its Bed & Breakfast package.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the hotel is actively operating in Harrison Hot Springs with amenities listed including complimentary wireless internet and outdoor parking, and explicitly mentions biking as a local activity. However, neither secure bike storage nor staff bike procedures are mentioned anywhere in the website content, leaving both required criteria as null. Phone (604.796.5555) and email (info@harrisonlakehotel.com) on the website match the OSM tags exactly.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Chilliwack' but the hotel is located in Harrison Hot Springs (postal code V0M 1K0 is Harrison Hot Springs, not Chilliwack) — community tag may be incorrect.
Website content is sparse (4618 bytes); bike storage and staff procedures are not addressed anywhere on the site.
